source.note: Official Digimon UP idle and walk frames, trimmed to a shared bounding box per species (1px padding, clamped). Playback 16 fps.

payload.recommendation: Use per-species PNG atlases in atlases-up-all/ and lazy-load by evolution line (starter egg line first, then any branch the run unlocks, plus the current wave's enemy species). Individual frames in frames-up-all/ are the source of truth and match the existing 16-species layout.
